final_message:
All tests pass now. The bug was in the build/lib/src/stats_utils.py file where the median function incorrectly returned `s[mid]` for even-length lists instead of averaging the two middle elements with `(s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2`. I've fixed it and verified all 5 tests pass.

The issue is that the build directory had a different (incorrect) version of stats_utils.py than the source file in src/. The fix ensures the median function now correctly calculates the median for even-length lists by averaging the two middle elements.
